title: The clay bulla — a corbelled dome grown around one brick (A2-S02)

scale.note: The wall's own scale: the bulla is the module become a container, so it is measured in the same bricks.

_stage: Act II stands its four scenes in a line along +X and walks the camera down it -- Uruk at 0, the bulla at 400 studs, the tokens from 700, Sardis at 1800. A show scene has no placement of its own, so the position is authored here, which is also where it belongs: the distance from Uruk to Sardis is a directorial fact, not a rendering one.
